Config.intro: Each character's wealth is stored as a single amount in the smallest denomination. The denominations below only define how that amount is split up and displayed.
Config.name: Currency name
Config.nameHint: Shown wherever the currency as a whole is meant, e.g. "Crowns".
Config.applyPresetConfirm: Replace all denominations with the selected preset? Unsaved changes are lost.
Config.label: Name
Config.factorHint: Exactly one denomination must have the value 1 (the base unit). Values must be unique whole numbers.

Errors.NoDenominations: The currency needs at least one denomination.
Errors.TooManyDenominations: A currency can have at most {max} denominations.
Errors.NoBaseDenomination: Exactly one denomination must have the value 1 (base unit).

Errors.DuplicateId: Two denominations have the same id.

Wallet.dragHint: Drag onto another character or the party sheet to hand over money (amount in base units).
Wallet.inputHint: Enter a number, or +n / -n to add or remove. Missing amounts are changed from higher denominations automatically.
Wallet.invalidInput: Please enter a whole number, optionally with + or -.
